question: Should this PR be redirected to a tracked dependency/build path with single-dollar parsing disabled, or is owner-approved vendoring and global parsing acceptable for Control UI math rendering?
rationale: The change executes new third-party code under the Control UI origin and changes how existing chat prose is interpreted, so automation should not choose the permanent security and product contract.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Require package/build provenance and remove `$...$` inline parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

options.title: Accept approved vendoring
options.body: Allow a vendored MathJax asset only with documented source, version, license, update process, and owner-approved review provenance.

options.title: Pause first-party math rendering
options.body: Keep this branch open or close it in favor of the canonical feature issue until maintainers decide whether core should own math rendering.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Require package/build provenance and remove `$...$` inline parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing owner from the likely-owner set for the same-origin script and Gateway security policy decision.
